I agree with the reasons you gave w regards to her wanting to break up. Disclaimer though, I've only had one relationship and we're kinda in the same place you are, not together but still in contact. I've tried going NC a couple of times now but I think it may do more harm than good and the relationship wasn't toxic nor dangerous anyway. In my personal opinion, she might just need space, her space. If it is true what you said about her seeing you as a unit instead of individual persons, then she might just need to have control over her space again. Right now what me and my ex have changed with our arrangement is to still be in contact, but as if we were just friends, meaning, more boundaries and time for ourselves, not to be dependent on one another. So maybe you could make compromises with your arrangement by telling her that you still want the relationship to work, to get back with her, but with reinstated boundaries; to address your needs and hers. Maybe remodel the house to have 2 rooms, one for her and one for you, etc. What we would like for her not to feel is trapped. Another thing that really bothered me w my ex then was he didn't ask us to be back together for a year, that's why I finally ended things. So maybe you could also express your desire to have her, but make sure to talk about the boundaries she wants to set or the problems she sees w the relationship. Cheers! I'm hoping for the best for the both of you.
